record.question: Who is known as the father of biodiversity?
record.explanation: Answer A: Edward O Wilson. E. O. Wilson is often called the father of biodiversity; this is an honorific description. Reference: https://www.nationalgeographic.com/science/article/e-o-wilson-biodiversity. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
